reply_text:
I answered Dana in her #north-team thread: the deadline for the signed order form at Thornbury Cloth Co. is **21 December**.

That date comes from Marcus's post in the same channel on 14 October. It's the only mention there, and nothing posted since changes it. It was his note rather than something I saw the team agree on, so I suggested she check with Marcus if she needs it confirmed as final before it goes in the tracker.
